text:
Arjun: Postmortem follow-up: we need explicit owners/timelines for remediation + the incident-driven testing additions (regression cases, promptset, load smoke, chaos).
Leah: I'll volunteer to coordinate the test additions. Can we split immediate "hotfix" items vs test-work?
Arjun: Yes. Hotfix (72h): change TTL tuning on KV cache and tighten client retry jitter. Test-work (2-6w): build incident promptset, expand regression harness, small load smoke, schedule chaos drill.
Priya: I'll own the TTL tuning + retry jitter. Plan: patch config -> staged rollout -> monitor 48h. ETA: 2026-04-01.
Leah: I'll own promptset and regression harness. Proposal: create a new promptset "incident-526-synthetics" with 20 targeted prompts (including edge-case short queries and repeated token bursts). Keep it separate for easier rollbacks.
Arjun: Good. Add metadata tags: incident=526, source=postmortem, created_by=Leah.
ops-bot: CI: nightly-run scheduled for new-evals at 2026-03-23T04:00:00Z
Leah: For the regression harness: include acceptance criteria per prompt (expected class, similarity threshold, and max token delta). Also add a flaky-tolerance guard that opens an issue after 5 flaps in a 7-day window.
Priya: Load smoke: 2k concurrent, 3 min ramp, verify P50/P95/P99, and cost-per-1k-tokens. I need infra approval for ephemeral capacity. Target 2 weeks.
Arjun: Chaos drill: simulate partial pod restart + cold KV eviction at steady traffic. Run only after regression harness and smoke pass. Tentative date 2026-04-15. Make it recoverable and document runbook.
Leah: CI snippet I'll add to evals repo:
```
# .github/workflows/incident-evals.yml
on: schedule
  - cron: '0 4 * * *'
jobs:
  run-evals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: ./tools/run_promptset --set incident-526-synthetics --report-to slack:#eng-ml
```
Priya: Ops snippet for monitoring KV TTL regressions:
```
alert: KV_TTL_Anomaly
expr: rate(kv_evictions[5m]) > 0.02
for: 10m
notify: #eng-oncall
```
Arjun: Create JIRA parent REM-526 and link child tasks: REM-526.1 TTL+retry, REM-526.2 promptset, REM-526.3 regression, REM-526.4 load-smoke, REM-526.5 chaos-drill. ETA notes in the tickets.
Leah: I'll open PRs today for the promptset + CI job (e.g., evals#411). Will include synthetic examples and expected outputs.
Priya: I'll open infra PR for staged config and guardrails (infra#209).
ops-bot: Calendar: Chaos drill tentative 2026-04-15 18:00 UTC.
Arjun: Acceptance criteria checklist: 1) Hotfixes in prod and stable for 48h. 2) New promptset runs nightly with <2% regression or alerts open. 3) Regression harness added to CI with pass/fail gating. 4) Load smoke passes without >5% error rate. 5) Chaos drill restores within SLO.
Leah: I'll document the runbook steps and add a PR template for incident-driven promptsets so future ones include model pins and expected outputs.
Priya: Linking runbook to postmortem and REM-526 parent ticket. Also will add oncall steps for quick rollback.
Arjun: Great work. Please update the parent JIRA when PRs land and paste links here. We'll re-check in one week. :white_check_mark:
